payload.title: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-008: Document and script local analyzer dry-run with fixtures
payload.body:
## Summary

Provide a **documented path** (and optional npm/pnpm script) to run the analyzer against **fixture JSON** representing a PR and issue locally, without calling GitHub Actions, to speed iteration and debugging.

## Scope

- In scope: Sample fixtures, README section, entrypoint that exercises parsing + LLM interface with mocks.
- Out of scope: Full `act` compatibility guarantees across all platforms unless trivially true.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A maintainer can follow docs to run the analyzer on **checked-in fixtures** with **no** GitHub API calls.
- [ ] Fixtures include at least: linked issue with checklist AC, PR diff snippet, and expected high-level outcome for regression tests where applicable.
- [ ] Document any required env vars for real LLM calls vs fully mocked runs.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-005
- Blocks: none

## Notes

Optional: mention [`nektos/act`](https://github.com/nektos/act) limitations in docs without committing to full support.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/pr-github-llm-ticket-acceptance.prd.md
